value.text: Virgin on St Anne's lap with Child reaching to St John; machinery; inscription

claims.statement: Recto: the main framed study shows the Virgin seated on St Anne's lap and the Child reaching towards St John, with other sketches and studies of machinery (bridge, weir or dam) and an inscription read as beginning 'fa coche dove lacq...'. Verso: variant of the group and a man's head in profile.

sources.cite: British Museum, collection online, 1875,0612.17. Read through search engine excerpts in this session; the page itself was not fetched in this session.
